typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberID as string,
		Outcome as string,
		PrescriberNPI as string,
		EOCStartDate as date,
		EOCEndDate as date,
		EOCID as string,
		CarrierID as string,
		PrescriberPhoneNumber as string,
		PrescriberFirstName as string,
		PrescriberLastName as string,
		PrescriberAddressLine1 as string,
		PrescriberStateCode as string,
		PrescriberCity as string,
		PrescriberZip as string,
		StateLicenseId as string,
		PrescriberDEA as string,
		PrescriberTaxonomyCode as string,
		Urgent as string,
		MemberFirstName as string,
		MemberLastName as string,
		MemberPhoneNumber as string,
		DesigneeFirstName as string,
		DesigneeLastName as string,
		DesigneePhoneNumber as string,
		DesigneeStateCode as string,
		LanguageCD as string,
		PhoneType as string,
		DesigneePostalCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(MemberID = MemberID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount split(length(PrescriberPhoneNumber) > 10 || length(PrescriberPhoneNumber) < 10 || length(MemberID) > 11 || length(EOCID) > 32, disjoint: true) ~> CheckFieldLengths@(FieldTooLong,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
CheckFieldLengths@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(FileIID = $File_IID,
		MEMBERNUMBER = MemberID + '00',
		CASE_STATUS = toString(('Closed - ' + Outcome)),
		ProviderAddressLine1Shortened = toString(left(PrescriberAddressLine1, 40)),
		Outcome = toString(left(Outcome, 55)),
		PrescriberStateCode = toString(left(PrescriberStateCode, 2))) ~> AddFileIdandMemberNumber
AddFileIdandMemberNumber derive(FileIID = FileIID) ~> PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount
PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount sink(input(
		DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROVIDER_STATE_LICENSE_ID as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NY_PA_STAGING_CASE_STATUS as string,
		DESIGNEE_STATE as string,
		PROVIDER_LAST_NAME as string,
		DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME as string,
		FILEIMPORT_IID as integer,
		PROVIDER_ZIP as string,
		PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		PROVIDER_ADDRESS1 as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		DESIGNEE_PHONE1_TYPE as string,
		DESIGNEE_PHONE1 as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		PROVIDER_PHONE as string,
		PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		PROVIDER_DEA as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_REASON as string,
		DESIGNEE_POSTAL_CODE as string,
		DESIGNEE_LANGUAGE_CD as string,
		URGENT as string,
		PROVIDER_STATE as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_pyID as string,
		PROVIDER_CITY as string,
		PROVIDER_TAXONOMY as string,
		MEMBER_Phone_Number as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME = DesigneeLastName,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE = EOCStartDate,
		PROVIDER_STATE_LICENSE_ID = StateLicenseId,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE = EOCEndDate,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CASE_STATUS = CASE_STATUS,
		DESIGNEE_STATE = DesigneeStateCode,
		PROVIDER_LAST_NAME = PrescriberLastName,
		DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME = DesigneeFirstName,
		FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID,
		PROVIDER_ZIP = PrescriberZip,
		PROVIDER_NPI = PrescriberNPI,
		PROVIDER_ADDRESS1 = ProviderAddressLine1Shortened,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME = MemberLastName,
		DESIGNEE_PHONE1_TYPE = PhoneType,
		DESIGNEE_PHONE1 = DesigneePhoneNumber,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME = MemberFirstName,
		PROVIDER_PHONE = PrescriberPhoneNumber,
		PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME = PrescriberFirstName,
		PROVIDER_DEA = PrescriberDEA,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_REASON = Outcome,
		DESIGNEE_POSTAL_CODE = DesigneePostalCode,
		DESIGNEE_LANGUAGE_CD = LanguageCD,
		URGENT = Urgent,
		PROVIDER_STATE = PrescriberStateCode,
		NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBERNUMBER,
		NY_PA_STAGING_pyID = EOCID,
		PROVIDER_CITY = PrescriberCity,
		PROVIDER_TAXONOMY = PrescriberTaxonomyCode,
		MEMBER_Phone_Number = MemberPhoneNumber)) ~> PDSNYPASTAGING
